2608.20953.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
2608.20953.paper_summary: Serving large language models cheaply increasingly means shipping models that are both structurally compressed to a fraction of their parameters and quantized to 4 bits. Together these steps degrade reasoning, mathematics, coding, and long-context behavior enough to require a recovery, or healing, stage before deployment. The default recipe, quantization-aware training (QAT), re-fits the compressed, quantized model to hard labels; in our pipeline it converged slowly and collapsed past its peak. We adopted Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH) instead. Because a structurally compressed model is never independently trained at full precision, its bfloat16 checkpoint is a distillation-recovered approximation of the original; QAH distills the 4-bit student directly from the original, uncompressed model. On a GPT-OSS 120B to 60B to MXFP4 pipeline, the QAH student matches or beats its bfloat16 source on 7 of 9 benchmarks at roughly 4 times less weight memory and half the teacher's parameter count, and is released open-weight as Hypernova-60B. Against a matched QAT baseline it reaches a comparable peak about 7 times faster and stays stable under continued training, without hand-tuned early stopping. We also report deployment lessons, including a large, reproducible quality gap between distributed-training backends. Our aim is a recipe deployable without a multi-week hyper-parameter search.
2608.20953.paper_summary_zh: 提供大型語言模型的廉價服務越來越意味著發送結構上壓縮到其參數的一小部分並量化到 4 位的模型。這些步驟共同降低了推理、數學、編碼和長上下文行為，足以需要在部署前進行恢復或修復階段。默認的配方，量化感知訓練（QAT），將壓縮的量化模型重新擬合到硬標籤；在我們的流程中，它收斂緩慢並在達到峰值後崩潰。我們改採量化感知修復（QAH）。因為結構上壓縮的模型從未以全精度獨立訓練，其 bfloat16 檢查點是原始模型的蒸餾恢復近似；QAH 直接從原始的未壓縮模型中蒸餾出 4 位學生。在 GPT-OSS 120B 到 60B 到 MXFP4 的流程中，QAH 學生在大約 4 倍較少的權重記憶和一半教師的參數數量上，在 9 個基準中的 7 個上與其 bfloat16 來源相匹配或超越，並以 Hypernova-60B 的開放權重釋出。與匹配的 QAT 基準相比，它以大約 7 倍的速度達到可比的峰值，並在持續訓練下保持穩定，無需手動調整的早期停止。我們還報告了部署經驗教訓，包括分佈式訓練後端之間存在的大且可重現的質量差距。我們的目標是一個可部署的配方，而不需要多週的超參數搜索。
